tei:div.tei:p: phag mo gru pa'i chos rgyud dang*/ bla rabs byon tshul bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru dpal phag mo gru pa'i chos rgyud/ bla rabs byon tshul ni/ bde gshegs rin po che/ khams pa rdor rgyal mya ngan las 'das rt-ing*/ thugs sras kyi thu bo ni/ bsod nams mthar phyin/ 'bri khung skyu ra chos rje/ phag gru dang*/ 'bri khung gnyis ka'i gdan sa lo mang bskyangs/ sku bgrais khar 'bri phag gdan sa gnyis su 'byon bzhud dka' bar byung*/ shas cher 'bri khung du bzhugs dus/ phag gru mthar brtsigs grwa slob rnams gros bsdur/ rje rin po che sku gnas bgres/ gdan sa khag gnyis skyong dgos pa/ da rang re rnams kyi mgo sdud/ gdan sa zhig bsko bar zhu zhus pa/ drag zer ba la kha 'cham/ ri pa che bgrais 'ga' 'bri khung du btang*/ rje dang mjal nas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ de bzhin cis kyang 'thad pas de'i 'os su 'dug khyed rang rnams kyi ltos gsungs khong rnams na re/ rje rin po che rang gi spyan mnga' na bzhugs pa'i/ gsol ja ba 'di 'dra ba zhig bsko bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o de yin de bzhin legs so gsungs/ ngas kyang byin gyis brlabs/ gdan drongs la song zhig khong gdan sar bskos rjes spyan lam nas byon pas/ de phyin spyan mnga' bar grags pa 'di byung ba yin/ de'i gdung rus rlangs lha gzigs yin/ mtshan lha rgyal ba byang chub kyang zer la/ spyan mnga' grags pa byang chub par grags so/ /des phag gru'i lha khang rnying ma bzhengs/ bstan pa dang gdan sa'i bya ba cher mdzad/ phyis khong pas kyang*/ 'bri khung gdan sa yang bskyangs shing*/ shas che ba 'bri khung du bzhugs/ phag gru'i gdan sa la/ khong rang gi dbon po/ lha rgyal ba ye shes pa bskos nas btang bas/ mal gro la thog tu phebs pa dang*/ mal gro gzi chen la sogs/ phar tshur gyi gzhi bdag gdug pa can 'ga' res/ bla ma'i nyams sad pa'i phyir du/ glo bur du sprin bsdus/ 'brug bsgrags/ thog ser phabs byung ba dang*/ bla mas chos gos thu ba bar snang la bzed pa dang*/

thog mda' lnga thu ba nang sran ma rgyug pa bzhin/ phar ril tshur ril du byed kyin 'dug ste/ bla ma dpon slob mi nor gang la'ang*/ thog gi gnod pa ma nus pas/ rgyal ba thog gdugs par grags shing*/ gdul bya dang snyan grags shin du che bar grags so/ /de'i sku tshe'i smad la/ stod hor rgyal po hu la hu'i brgya 'bul/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis thog drangs pa'i 'bul mo che blangs/ de nas zhag bcu bdun song ba dang*/ rgyal ba rin po che grongs/ de'i dbon po rin po che bcu gnyis pas gdan sa mdzad nas/ rgyal ba rin po che'i nang rten la/ gser gyi sgo mang bzhengs/ gdan sa mthil gyi sgo mang snga ma yin no/ /de'i slob ma la/ spu rtogs zer/ khong grongs nas/ spu rtogs tshos bla ma'i nang rten la sgo mang zhig bzhengs/ gdan sa bcu gnyis pa'i dbon po che ba/ gcen grags ye bskos/ de'i slob ma la ldol spu zer/ spu ldol gyi chags sdang de nas byung*/ rin po che grags pas/ sa skya pa'i bla ma 'phags pa la/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa zhus/ bla ma shar pa ye shes rin chen pa la/ khong rang gi snag tsha/ dbon po grags le ba phul/ des sa skya pas phag gru'i gdan sa bsko grab byas pas/ gcung rgyal pos bkrongs/ de mtshams rin po che grags ye grongs nas/ gcung rgyal po grags rin pas gdan sa mdzad/ sa skya'i grags le dbon pos 'kham gcung bsko grab byas pa la| gcung rgyal po'i rting 'bri khung pas mnan nas/ sa 'bri 'thab pa'i 'go tshugs/ phag gru rang la skyon cher ma byung na'ang*/ sa 'bri yun ring po 'khrugaphyi'i gcung rgya bos bla dpon sbrel nas mdzad/ de grongs nas khong gi dbon po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa pho byi ba lo la gdan sa la bskaus pa yin/ khong rang grongs nas de'i dbon po rigs rgyud/ spyan mnga' grags byang pa gdan sar bskaus/ lo 'ga' sne gdong khri thog dang*/ slob dpon sbrags pa mdzad/ de gshegs rting*/

gcung po grags pa rin chen pa phag gru'i gdan sar bskos/ de'i rjes la/ khri dpon shāka rin gyi sras po/ spyan mnga' bsod nams dpal ba dang*/ bsod nams bzang po ba/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa sku mched rnams kyi rim par gdan sa mdzad/ chu mo glang gi lo'i gsham la/ spyan snga chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa sku mched gshegs/ de'i gshegs rdzongs kyi skabs shing pho stag gi lo/ srog sme brgyad dkar dbus su shar ston nas/ phag gru nang zing la bstan pas/ dbus gtsang bde dog chen mo langs pa yin/ bde gshegs bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje yi/ /dbus gtsang bde zhing thub bstan gsal ba dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i gdan sa ma stong bar/ /sgrub rgyud nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal bar shog /mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i spyan lnga ni/ sha'i spyan/ lha'i spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang lnga'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/phag mo grub pa'i chos rgyud dang*/ bla rabs byon tshul/ -PAGE 266--PAGE 265--PAGE 264-
